Commentary.Commentary: Not a lot to write about the Ireland batting. Nobody could cope with the swing and the spin of the Pakistan bowlers. Kevin O'Brien did look good while he was batting but he too fell 10 short of a fifty. He was their highest scorer. They trail by a massive 180 runs and are way behind in the game. We still have 26 overs left in the game and the away side will look to get a few scalps tonight itself. We will be back shortly.

Pakistan have enforced the follow-on! Tell you what, they have done so for the first time in 16 years! That should be some record! Summary - The Pakistan bowlers have done an excellent job. It took them only a little more than a session to bundle the Irish batsmen out. Mohammad Abbas, Shadab Khan were the pick of the bowlers with the spinner getting 3 and the pacer finishing with four. They were well supported by Amir who also picked up two of his own.

OUT! Gone! Ireland's first innings with the bat in a Test match doesn't turn out to be the way they would have liked. Shadab Khan gets a 3-fer. Quicker through the air, Murtagh looks to block it but gets a thick inside edge towards short leg. Imam-ul-Haq stationed there is sharp as a hawk and makes no mistake. IRELAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 130!
Drifting in on middle and leg, kept out watchfully.

FOUR! He does not get a single but gets three more than that! Full and outside off, Wilson slashes at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes over gully for a boundary. Pakistan won't mind that as Murtagh is on strike.
Shortish and outside off, Wilson tries to be a touch expansive as he goes for a cut by making room but does not connect. One ball to go, Wilson will be looking for a single here. Can he get it?
Fuller outside off, this one shapes back in. Wilson goes for a drive but does not account for the movement into him. He is beaten on the inside.
Length outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length around off, it is defended.
Fires it on the pads, Wilson works it around the corner for a run. The good thing for Ireland is he will keep strike.
Slower through the air outside off, Wilson lets it be.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! This is short and outside off, the batsman rocks back and cuts it through short third man and the ball races away. 36 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Flighted ball on off, kept out.
Loopy ball on off, it is defended.
FOUR! Brings in the innovation and is rewarded with a boundary! Goes for the reverse sweep, connects well and sends it through short third man for a boundary.
Good length on middle, it is pushed towards mid on for a quick run.
Good field placement by Sarfraz. He has kept a third man in place and this goes exactly to him as Murtagh edges it. The batsmen take a run.
Shortish and outside off, Murtagh swings but misses.
FOUR! Murtagh shows he can hold the bat too! Short and on middle, Murtagh takes on the challenge of pulling it. He connects well and the ball races through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Good length on off, pushed towards covers.
Good length outside off, left alone.
FOUR! This time he connects with the sweep well, finds the gap and the ball races away to the square leg fence. Wilson now has to look to score here.
Comes down the track a bit too early. Seeing that Shadab shortens the length, the batsman adjusts and defends it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Flights it on off, Wilson once again goes for the sweep shot. He misses. The ball hits the pads and goes towards first slip. There is a muted appeal from the bowler but nothing from the umpire.
Plays the sweep shot but straight to the fielder at backward square leg.

OUT! Inside edge and taken! Finally the frustrating stand for Pakistan has been broken. Ireland are nine down now. On a length around off, Rankin goes for the booming drive away from his body. The ball shapes in a touch, takes the inside edge and goes into the gloves off the keeper.
Fuller and on middle, Rankin drives it back to the bowler.
Another ball on a length around off, Rankin comfortably defends it.
Shorter in length on off, it is pushed to covers.
Bowled on a length around off, the batsman lets it be.
Fuller in length on off, defended towards covers.
The googly, Wilson picks it and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Lofts this loopy ball over the bowler's head for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Rankin keeps it out.

DROPPED! Shadab should have taken that and he has also got a good pair of hands. He floats this up on off, Rankin hits it hard back towards the bowler. Khan gets two hands to it but can't hang on. He will be disappointed with himself.
Slower through the air on off, it is driven through covers for a run.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, left alone.
Length again outside off, Rankin tries to force it through the off side but gets beaten.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is on the pads, Rankin flicks it fine through the leg side for a boundary.
Another stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire. On a length around middle, Rankin tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Streaky but Ireland will take it! These are handy runs for the home side. On a length and around off, it straightens. Boyd tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through the slip cordon for a boundary.
On the pads, the batsman misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
The leg spinner on off, Wilson defends it.
Shorter outside off, the batsman chops it towards point for a run.
Tucks it around the corner with the turn.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Very full on middle, it is jammed out to the bowler.
A huge appeal but not given! The leg spinner on off, Boyd plays for the non-existent turn and misses. It hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Looked very close.
Shabad Khan to bowl from the other end.
Well left! This one first angles into off and then leaves the batsman. Wilson first thinks of playing at it but then lets it be.
Outside off, left alone.
First run of this session! On middle, tucked around the corner for a run.
Good length on off, the batsman keeps it out.
Length delivery and on middle, Rankin tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A loosener to start off with. Wide outside off, the batsman lets it be.

Out come the players for the last session. 38 overs to go, so we can expect a long one. Boyd Rankin and Gary Wilson will continue their innings. Mohammad Abbas will start the proceedings for Pakistan. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 3...

A session which has yet again been dominated by Pakistan. The Irish batsmen looked clueless in testing conditions, both against pace and spin. Shadab Khan was the pick of the bowlers as he bamboozled the hosts with his wide array of variations. It was only Kevin O'Brien who played a gutsy knock. The home side still needs 66 runs to avoid the follow-on but it seems highly unlikely. Join us shortly for the final session.
Shorter in length, cut away towards backward point. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 3!
Slow through the air outside off, played with soft hands towards slip.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length, Gary  hangs back and cuts it towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Haris Sohail is brought into the attack.
Leg bye! Spinning down leg, catches Rankin's pad and rolls to the leg side. A single taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
That's a peach! Sharp googly on middle, too good for the lanky batsman and beats him all ends up.
That was close! Tossed up on middle, spinning down. Rankin comes forward to block it but misses to get hit on the front pad. An animated appeal follows but the umpire doesn't budge.
Tries to drive this one but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shorter in length, Rankin defends it off the back foot.
Camps back to the short of a length delivery and defends it stoutly.
On a length on middle and leg, tucked off the back foot to the leg side.
Wide! Dug in short but it is wayward this time, Wilson ducks under it with ease. One bouncer for the over signaled by the umpire.

How unlucky is Amir not to get a wicket off that delivery? A pinpoint yorker, tailing in substantially. Ranking is late to bring his bat down but somehow manages to get an inside edge past his leg stump towards fine leg. A run taken.
On a good length outside off, played with an open bat face towards point.
Length delivery around off, kept out with minimal foot movement.
Four byes! Sharp short ball, it rises too high. Rankin takes evasive action as the ball goes past him. The keeper leaps but the ball goes past him and reaches the fence.
Hangs back to the shorter delivery and punches it towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball, kept out watchfully.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
An appeal for an LBW is turned down! Fullish and quick in pace, Rankin tries to defend it but is hit on the pads. Pakistan appeal but the umpire stays put. That was going down leg.
Turning in from outside off, Rankin tries to clip it away but is hit on the thigh pad.
Shaping away from Wilson as he lets it be.
Outside off again, Wilson lets it be.
Fuller in length, eased off the front foot to covers.
On a good length outside off, third leave in a row.
In the zone outside off, Gary doesn't flirt with it.
Outside off, left alone.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.

FOUR! A really tough chance goes down! You are lucky if those stick. Tossed up outside off, Wilson goes for a drive with hard hands but gets an outside edge. The ball ricochets off Sarfraz's pad and goes past the slip fielder in a flash.
Quicker one, takes the outside edge of Rankin's bat and goes towards third man. A run taken.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.

Four Byes! That missed everything! Slow through the air around off, Wilson goes for a big hit down the ground but has left a big gap between his bat and pad. The ball sneaks through it and deceives the keeper to reach the fence.
Shorter in length outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Full, fast and swinging in, Rankin is up to it as he dead-bats it.
Back of a length ball around off, Rankin stands tall and taps it to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller length ball around off, Boyd strides ahead and pushes it to the cover region.

A close shave! On a length, tailing in prodigiously. Ranking tries to defend it but is late. Is hit flush on the front pad as Amir goes up in a vociferous appeal. The umpire stays put. The replays indicate that it was sliding down leg.
On a length on the pads, worked away nicely through square leg to pick up a couple of runs.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That's a ripper! Gives this one a lot of revs and bowls it on middle, Wilson strides forward to defend but the sharp away turn catches him off guard.
Continues to toss it up, Gary blocks it out.
Similar delivery, Wilson strides forward and deals it with nicely.
Tossed up delivery, Wilson strides ahead and defends it nicely.
Brilliant yorker on middle, Rankin is alert to it and does well to block it.
Full ball outside off, tapped to point.
Boyd Rankin strides out to bat.

OUT! Ireland are falling like a pack of cards! The mainstay has to make the long walk back now. Fullish delivery outside off, angling across. O'Brien goes for a booming drive but doesn't bother to keep it down. Imam-ul-Haq is safe as a house and takes a nice catch. A good knock comes to an end.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Fuller in length outside off, O'Brien leans into it and pushes it to covers.
Hangs back to the short of a length delivery and keeps it out.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
Quicker one this time, tucked to square leg.
Brilliantly bowled! Slow through the air, spinning away sharply. Wilson prods forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the cover region.
Slips in the googly, Gary reads it well and keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker one outside off, stays low as well. Wilson gets deceived and misses his cut.
Shortish ball around the rib-cage area, Wilson hops and works it to square leg for a quick run.
This one is wide outside off, Wilson has got nothing to do with it.
Fullish delivery around off, Gary strides forward and blocks it out.
Angling across sharply from Wilson. He doesn't fiddle with it.
On a length, angling across Kevin. He dabs it to third man to rotate strike.
Slightly overpitched around off, Kevin O'Brien drives it towards mid off.
Floated delivery, kept out in a good manner.
Too short this time, slapped to deep cover to rotate strike.
Slow through the air, dealt with expertly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Leans ahead to the tossed up ball and defends it nicely.
A stifled appeal for an LBW turned down! Slips in the googly and it turns in sharply, Kevin lunges to block it but is hit on the pads. The umpire stays put to the appeals. It was sliding down leg.
Short ball on off, pulled nicely to deep backward square leg for a run.
Loose from O'Brien! Full length ball outside off, luring Kevin to drive. He goes for a booming drive but gets beaten.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, trying to tuck the batsman up. O'Brien hangs back and blocks it stoutly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good running! On a length outside off, Wilson drives it towards covers and steal a swift single.
Fuller in length in line of the stumps, Kevin looks to play it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen sneak in a run.
On a length around off, kept out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on off, Wilson lunges and keeps it out.
Flatter and outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Clever shot! Knew there was nobody at fine leg. He goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine through the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
On a length around middle, Wilson tries to defend but gets an inside edge through square leg for a run.
Wide outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
On a length around off, Wilson defends it onto the ground.
A yorker outside off, the batsman jams it out.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Rahat Ali is back on.
Shorter in length outside off, Wilson pushes it through point for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Wilson lunges forward and tries to keep it out.
Gary Wilson comes out to bat.

OUT! Second in the over for Shadab. The googly does the trick for him. It pitches and turns back in. Kane has no idea on which way the ball is turning. He goes back and tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads and it lobs to second slip who takes an easy catch. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
Loopy ball way outside off, left alone.
Tyrone Kane is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Thompson has missed a straigth ball. It is bowled on off, he looks to work it across the line which is never a good idea. He pays the price for that and sees the stumps get disturbed. Shadab gets his first and Ireland still trail by another 249.
Loopy ball on off, it turns back in. The southpaw goes for the drive but gets it off the inner half towards short leg.
Good length around off, it is guided towards gully who makes a good stop diving to his left.
FOUR! Classy! Ashraf bowls it a little too full and Kevin times it through extra cover and it races away.
Length ball outside the off stump. Stirling tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
FOUR! Shorter in length outside off, O'Brien tries to defend but it goes off the outside edge and through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Length ball on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Length ball around off, it is defended towards covers.
Tosses this one up on off, it is defended.
A little too short again on off, the batsman punches it to covers.
Slightly on the shorter side. The batsman rocks back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker on off, defended.
The googly on off, Kevin lunges and keeps it out.
Flatter and on the stumps, the batsman defends it out.
Shadab Khan is into the attack.
Full on off, driven to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length on off, it is once again defended onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, it is defended.
Beauty! On a length around off, this one takes off after pitching. Thompson tries to defend but is done in by the extra bounce.
Fullish and on off, it is stroked to the man at mid off.
Length around off, guided to point.
Fullish in length on off, it is pushed towards covers for a quick run.
Short and on the body, Kevin pulls it through square leg for a run.
Fullish in length on off, it is driven to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller delivery on middle, pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Dabbed away! Waits for the ball to come and then at the very last moment he opens the face of the bat to guide it past gully for a boundary. Deft!
Stuart looks to drive this away but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery on middle, it's been pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Kevin O'Brien drives this fuller ball straight to mid off.
Fuller on off, driven to the man at covers.
Once again attacks the stumps and the batsman defends it onto the ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length and on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Once again goes after a ball which is way outside off, a needless shot. He gets beaten again.
BEATEN! The batsman fishes for a ball outside off but luckily for him the ball does not take the edge.
On a fuller length outside off, driven straight to the man at cover.
Fuller and slightly wider on off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Fuller and on the stumps, jammed out back to the bowler.
Lovely one-handed stop! Short of a good length outside off, O'Brien punches it on the up towards cover but Imam-ul-Haq dives to his right and makes a classy stop.
Hangs back to a harmless length ball outside off, patted into the cover region.
Angling in from a length outside off, a poke and a miss from Kevin.
Fuller and this one shapes away from the southpaw, Thompson pushes it off the outer half towards point.
Taps this length delivery in front of cover and scampers across for a brisk single.
On middle and off, pushed off the inner half to mid on.
Angling away on a length around off, O'Brien tries to push it away but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball lobs near the vacant short leg region.
Back of a length around middle, blocked.
FOUR! Good shot! Ahead of a length, served outside off, Kevin leans ahead and unfurls a gorgeous shot through cover, off the middle and it races away.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. A good first over from Ashraf!
Once again drives it to the mid off region.
Gets forward to a fuller ball and eases it to mid off.
Stuart Thompson is the new man in.

OUT! That's gone straight up in the air! Faheem Ashraf is having a dream debut Test! Scored runs with the bat and now strikes in his very first over. A nothing shot there from Stirling. Short of a length delivery outside off, Paul half-heartedly goes for a pull shot and that brings his downfall. The ball takes the top edge and balloons high in the air towards mid off where Babar Azam takes a simple catch. The stand that was starting to build has been cut short. Half the Ireland side back in the hut.
He likes that area, Kevin! Good length ball outside off, Stirling unfurls a square drive through point. Beats the dive of the fielder there and collects a brace.
Begins his Test bowling career with a fuller length delivery outside off, Kevin drives it along the ground towards mid off and calls for a quick single.
Faheem Ashraf, the debutant is brought into the attack now. He had a great time with the bat. Can he emulate with the cherry?
Stays behind the line and stabs it out.
Slightly ahead of a length outside off, it's punched down to mid off for a single.
Shaping back in from around middle stump line, Kevin tries to work it away but squirts it off the inner half through backward square leg for a couple.
Gets across to a fuller delivery does Kevin and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Strangles down the leg side, a clip and a miss from Kevin.
Right on target! Fuller delivery from over the wicket and curling back in on middle, O'Brien works it to short mid-wicket.
First change for Pakistan. It's the tall Rahat Ali who is brought into the attack.
FOUR! Smashed away! Short of a length delivery outside off, ordinary stuff from Abbas. Paul hits it hard through point and picks up another boundary. 14 off the over, a fruitful one for the Irish!
Oooooo! Brave leave, gotta say! This one is landed outside off and it threatens to come back in, Paul plants his front foot across, knows where his off stump is and then shoulders his arms.

Beautifully played! Another overpitched delivery outside off, O'Brien leans ahead and drives it down the ground past mid off. The sluggish outfield won't fetch him a boundary but they come back for the third. This is turning out to be a good scoring over for the hosts.
Abbas in search of swing to bowl that dream delivery ends up straying on the pads, it dips in on the leg stump. Paul shuffles across and clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Now shuffles across to a delivery angled in and works it with the angle through square leg for a couple more. Stirling is the only Irish batsman so far who has got his feet moving.
FOUR! Shot! Short of a length delivery outside off, Stirling's eyes light up as he sees the width. He gets on top of the bounce and slaps it square on the off side and it blazes away to the fence.
Keeps it full again, coming back in a shade, pushes back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Perfect yorker delivered by Amir! Right into the blockhole, this one tails back in as well, O'Brien just about manages to dig this out. Wasim Akram would be really proud of that delivery for sure.
Back of a length around middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Presses ahead to a good length delivery and defends it off the outer half towards gully.
Slants it away on a length outside off, tempting delivery. Kevin has a slash at it but gets beaten. Should leave those.
Slightly overpitched outside off, pushed straight to the man at mid off.
Fuller outside off, Stirling taps it towards point and asks his partner to stay there.
Much better from Kevin. This should settle him down. Takes a stride ahead to a fuller delivery and eases it down the ground through mid off. Won't get a boundary but will pick up three runs.
Stays back and blocks it out well.

FOUR! Inside edgeeee! Nearly another one! Abbas bowls a length delivery outside off, Kevin sans any feet movement tries to hit it through the line but gets a thick inside edge which evades the off stump and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Strays down the leg side, O'Brien tries clipping it away but fails to put any bat on it.
Good length delivery on off, Kevin brings his bat down and defends it well.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Back of a length on off, the batsman rocks back and keeps it out.
Length ball outside the off pole. The batsman makes a leave.
Top shot! Full and on off, Stirling leans into it and strokes it through covers. Due to the slow outfield the batsmen only get two.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide outside off, Stirling mistimes his drive to covers.
Almost another one! On a length around off, it stays low. Kevin tries to defend but the ball hits the bottom part and almost goes back onto the stumps. Abbas is on a roll!
Kevin O'Brien walks out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! So the Pakistan bowlers continue to create havoc in the Irish batting line-up. The inswinger on middle, it comes back in. Niall tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. It looked adjacent and replays later on show it was the right decision. Ireland are now staring down the barrel.
Angles this away from the batsman. Niall first thinks of playing at it but then pulls out of the shot.
Fullish on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Abbas who is bowling from the other end lands it on a length ball around off, Niall defends it onto the ground.
Another length ball angling across the batsman. He defends it.
Length on off, Stirling defends it onto the ground.
Angles this one away outside off, Stirling lets it be.
On middle, shaping back in. Stirling tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg for a brace.

Action straightaway as there is appeal for an LBW. Once again it is the inswinger on the pads. Stirling tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The impact was an issue there.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. Out come the players and the umpires. Niall O'Brien and the new batsman, Paul Stirling walk out to the middle. Mohammad Amir will continue his over. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Ireland still trail by another 305 runs and that looks a long way away at the moment. They need Niall O'Brien and the next batsman coming in to build a huge partnership and steady things after this early dent. Will they be able to do so or will the Pakistan pacers wreak havoc? Join us in a short while for the second session...

What a session for Pakistan! First, the crossed 300 on the board and now are all over Ireland. The Irish batsmen had to bat out around 30 minutes before the first interval but they have lost three and three huge wickets. That just shows it was an excellent call by Sarfraz to declare and it has paid huge dividends. Abbas picked the first two and on the first ball of the last over before Lunch, Amir bowled a cracker to get rid of the Irish captain.

OUT! Off stump goes for a walk! A brilliant sight for a bowler but not a good one for the batsman. Amir goes wide of the crease and lands it on a length around off, this one shapes back in late. William Porterfield is late to bring his bat down and by the time he does, the ball sneaks through and uproots the off stick apart. Another batsman walks back for a single digit score and Ireland are in a torrid situation at LUNCH, DAY 3!
On a length outside off, it comes back in. The batsman makes a leave.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a length around off, defended.
Wide outside off, left alone.
On the pads, O'Brien goes for the flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Niall O'Brien walks out to the middle.

OUT! There goes another one! Once again it's Abbas, he gets his second and this looks plumb to the naked eye. On a length around middle, Balbirnie plants his front foot way too across and tries to hit it down the ground. He misses to get rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Ireland are two down with nothing on the board.
Outside off, WP shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller and angling in on middle, worked towards mid on for nothing.
In the channel outside off, William plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Drops it around the back of a length mark, a bit close to the off stump channel, nothing doing says, Porterfield.
Gets across to a length delivery and defends it on the leg side.
On a length and outside off, Porterfield makes an easy leave.

NOT OUT! Andy is safe! But a brilliant effort by Imam. What reflexes shown by him. This is on the pads, Balbirnie works it towards short leg. He sets off for a run thinking it will pass the fielder there. He was wrong though as Imam dives to his right, collects the ball and scores a direct hit by flicking the ball at the striker's end. The players appeal as they feel they have got their man. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show Andy is in due to his dive. The Ireland dugout will breathe a sigh of relief as they would not want to lose another now.
Has Imam-ul-Haq pulled out something brilliant? He has scored a direct hit at the striker's end. Balbirnie is the man in question...
Closer to the off pole this time but not close enough to make him play.
Length again on off, Andrew pushes it back to the bowler.
Another length ball outside off, Balbrinie makes another solid leave.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Attacks the stumps on off, Balbirnie lunges and defends it.
Another length ball angling away from the batsman. He makes a leave.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
On a length around off, William keeps it out.

Second time in a row! The batsman can just hope he does not edge such deliveries. On a length and angling into the batsman. It straightens after pitching. William tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
BEATEN! On a length around off, this one shapes away. William pokes at it and gets beaten.
A little wide outside off, Porterfield makes a leave.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it down onto the ground.
Andrew Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! Abbas draws first blood! An early wicket for Pakistan. Just the start they needed. This is landed on a length around the leg stump. Joyce shuffles across and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players make a huge appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Joyce has to walk back early and the Pakistan players are ecstatic. A harsh call on the batsman there as replays later on show that the ball is marginally pitching outside leg.
Back of a length on off, Joyce keeps it out.
